project: Atlas One additive release security hardening

preservation.method: Security files are additive; protected changes apply only to the disposable build stage.

validated: Original English voice build stage prepares successfully
Secure stage integration completes with guarded anchors
Cleartext traffic disabled in staged Android manifest
Android cloud backup and device transfer excluded for private app data
System certificate trust only; user-installed CA certificates are not trusted by default
Startup initialization has a safe recovery path
GitHub workflow YAML parses with push and manual triggers
Workflow requires a private fixed release key and never falls back to debug signing
Workflow verifies APK signature and rejects debuggable APKs
Google Play AAB output is wired
reason_deferred: Flutter and Android build tools are not installed in the editing runtime. The workflow runs these checks and uploads artifacts only after success.
play_protect_note: A correctly signed sideloaded APK may still show an unknown-developer warning. Public installation without that sideload warning requires distribution through Google Play and Play App Signing.
